newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait oil production not affected by fire - KOC.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait oil production not affected by fire - KOC.

text.p: Kuwait's oil production was not affected by a fire that broke out near an oil gathering centre, a Kuwait Oil Company official said on Monday.
"It (fire) had no impact on production. We did not produce a drop less," the official said. "The fire was away from our gathering centres," he added.
A fire broke out on Sunday in Kuwait in an oil lake east of gathering centre 10 of al-Magwa oil field but caused no damage to oil installations or injuries and was brought under control.
The fire started when cluster bombs left over from the 1991 Gulf War being detonated set fire to dry grass, the official Kuwait News Agency has said.
Oil lakes were formed by oil leaking and gushing from oil installations and wells damaged during the 1991 Gulf War.
